## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`), n = +1.0 → +3.24×10¹², B 1.2 → 10 T uniform in 1/B

> **05:32** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n +1.0->+3.24e12 (61 pts, dn 0.037) fast paired (Vtg,Vbg), B 1.2->10 T uniform-1/B 100 rows (D(1/B)=1/(4 F\_L(n\_max))) slow; fast\_delay 1.8 s (6 tau), slow\_delay 1 s, sr1 100 uV (10 kOhm FS); ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~10:32** (≈5h)

**Why this fan (spot-check read, runs 6/7 — ana).** Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T): a 7.2 T tone alive to the valid-sampling edge (`sdh_onset` censored at 1.0 T, SNR ≈ 100; Rxx minima reach ~0 Ω from 1.4 T), 22.3 T (onset 1.4 T), 29.4 T (onset 1.8 T), and a comb at 2×/4×/6×/8× of 7.3 T; above 4 T the record is dominated by a ~30 T tone with its own 60/90 T harmonics. Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2, F_L = 12.4 T): 4.7 / 6.6 / 12.3 T — the close-pair near-CNP regime. Two readings fit one density: **(a) ABAB at a global density scale ≈ 0.89** — pair 7.2 + 22.3 = 29.5 T = F_L′ with the symmetry-allowed sum/breakdown tone at F_L′ (model pair at n = 3.2: 7.3 + 25.8 T; partition 0.24/0.76 measured vs 0.22/0.78 model); **(b) one strongly anharmonic 7.3 T oscillation** whose 3rd/4th harmonics are the 22/29 T peaks, with a separate F_L-scale ladder at high B. Only n-dependence separates them: a harmonic sits at k·f_light at every n, while the ABAB heavy tone follows its own curve (model heavy/light ratio 6.6 at n = 1.5 → 3.5 at n = 3.25; it crosses 3 only above this fan's range). The electron side is the fan side: higher |n|, separated tones; the hole side reaches only −1.27×10¹² inside the validators and sits in the close-pair regime.

**Design (recipe step 1, computed).** Fast axis: D = 0 n-line 1.0 → 3.24×10¹², 61 pts (Δn 0.037), (V_tg, V_bg) from (+0.353, +0.351) to (+0.995, +1.181) V — 5 mV under TG_MAX; run-5 calibration (ratio 0.773, n_offset −0.089, D_offset −0.013). Slow axis: `field_invB(1.2, 10, 100)`: Δ(1/B) = 1/(4·F_L(3.24)) = 0.0074 /T → sampling 135 T, Nyquist 67.5 T — the F_L tone and its 2nd harmonic unaliased in every column; a 30 T tone's 3rd/4th harmonics alias to 45 / 15 T (stated; off the claimed tones). **B_lo = 1.2 T**: the onset is censored at the record's valid edge (1.0 T lower bound); 1.2 T is the 5-period floor for the 7.2 T partner (1.26 T) — the 22 rows in 1.0–1.2 T would cost ≈ 46 min for 0.17 /T of light-tone record and are not taken. Record 0.733 /T → δF = 1.36 T (2.2 T from the 1.8 T sum-tone onset); the 22 T tone gets 16 periods, the 29 T tone 13. n-axis Nyquist: ν = 4 ray spacing at 1.2 T = 0.116×10¹² → 3.1 pts/period (≥ 7 above 3 T). Dwell: `fast_delay` 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — the per-column-FFT floor, recipe step 7 / burn #8), `slow_delay` 1 s after the blocking field set (+3 s driver settle). Sensitivity fixed at **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS**: worst corner n = 1.0 × 10 T — R(B = 0) is 117 Ω there vs 56 Ω at n = 3.2 (run 5), so ≈ 2.1× the 530 Ω spot-check maximum ≈ 1.1 kΩ, ×2–3 for broken-symmetry QH maxima → ≥ 3× headroom; the low-B SdH swing (15 Ω) is 0.15 % FS, where the spot check at 0.3 % gave SNR ≈ 100.

**Cost (from runs 5–7 timing: 0.17 s/pt readback, 3 s settle, 0.137 T/min).** 100 rows × (61 × 1.97 s + 5 s) = 208 min + 73 min ramps (0 → 1.2 T positioning + 8.8 T traverse) = 4.7 h; realistic **≈ 5 h**. Ends at **10 T, gates parked at 0** — the next step (LK mass split, `temperature-dependence-vti`, at n = +3.2) rides the magnet down. **Coverage trade:** hole side not in this fan (doubles the row time, +3.5 h, in the weakly-discriminating close-pair regime); n < 1.0 excluded (model light pocket < 0.6 T, unresolvable in any window; CNP corner threatens the scale). Region B (electron-doped by 0.43×10¹² vs A, run 5) is a series mosaic: expect satellite tones at n + 0.43 (×1.13 at n = 3.2) — carried into the read.

**Checkpoints.** First 3 rows (~20 min after start, after positioning): signal level, no rail at the low-n end, gate currents at the pA floor, field readback tracking the 1/B grid. At ~2 T (row 45, ≈ 1 h 40 m): per-column FFT of the landed record — the 7 T tone across n. At ~4 T (row 82, ≈ 3 h 20 m): interim tone-set read (22 T tone vs 3×f_light across n). Abort on a sustained rail or a leak trip; otherwise run to 10 T. Preconditions printed at the top: T_sample at base, B ≈ 0, V_si = 0, PS heater on / output enabled, Keithley nplci = 1.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`): n +1.0 -> +3.24e12 (61 pts) x B 1.2 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (100 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB
import scipy.constants as _cst

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts by ramping to 1.2 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at zero: {_B0} T"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- fast axis: D = 0 n-line (region-A calibration) ---
n_lo, n_hi, N_n = 1.0, 3.24, 61                    # 1e12 cm^-2
ns = np.linspace(n_lo, n_hi, N_n); D0 = 0.0
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, np.full_like(ns, D0), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert abs(_nchk - ns).max() < 1e-6 and abs(_Dchk).max() < 1e-9

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B, Delta(1/B) = 1/(4 F_L(n_hi)) -> F_L and its 2nd harmonic unaliased in every column ---
B_lo, B_hi = 1.2, 10.0
F_L_max = _cst.h / (4 * _cst.e) * n_hi * 1e16     # T
N_B = int(np.ceil((1 / B_lo - 1 / B_hi) * 4 * F_L_max)) + 1
B_vec = field_invB(B_lo, B_hi, N_B)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
_dinv = abs(np.diff(1 / B_vec)).mean()
_ray = 4 * _cst.e / _cst.h * B_lo * 1e-16          # nu = 4 ray spacing at B_lo, 1e12 cm^-2
print(f"fan: n {n_lo} -> {n_hi} e12 ({N_n} pts, dn {ns[1]-ns[0]:.4f}), Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; "
      f"B {B_lo} -> {B_hi} T, {N_B} rows uniform-1/B, Delta(1/B) = {_dinv:.5f} 1/T (F_L(n_hi) = {F_L_max:.1f} T, Nyquist {0.5/_dinv:.1f} T); "
      f"n-axis {_ray/(ns[1]-ns[0]):.1f} pts per nu=4 ray at B_lo")

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0                  # 6 tau at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB (per-column-FFT floor); field set blocks + 3 s driver settle
I_TRIP = 1e-9
SR1_SENS = 100e-6                                   # 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA — worst corner n = 1.0 x 10 T (~1-3 kOhm expected)
sr1.sensitivity(SR1_SENS)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; "
      f"est. {N_B * (N_n * (FAST_DELAY + 0.17) + 5) / 60 + 73:.0f} min")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D = 0: n {n_lo} -> {n_hi} e12 ({N_n} pts) fast (Vtg, Vbg paired), B {B_lo} -> {B_hi} T slow, {N_B} rows uniform-1/B; "
                  f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, sr1 {SR1_SENS*1e6:.0f} uV; run-5 cal")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = {n_lo} to {n_hi} e12 ({N_n} pts), B = {B_lo} to {B_hi} T ({N_B} rows, uniform 1/B, Delta(1/B) = 1/(4 F_L(n_hi))); '
              f'electron side; cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s (6 tau), sr1 sens {SR1_SENS*1e6:.0f} uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, T_sample, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(T_sample)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

_rail = {"n": 0}
def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[4])), abs(float(data[5]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if abs(float(data[9])) > 0.9 * SR1_SENS and _rail["n"] < 5:
        _rail["n"] += 1
        print(f"RAIL WARNING sr1 X = {float(data[9])*1e6:.1f} uV (>0.9 FS) at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V")
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
# field is left at the fan's end (10 T) deliberately: the next step (LK mass split at n = +3.2) rides it down.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (left here), gates parked (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), rail warnings {_rail['n']}")
